title.en: Built-in Node.js runtime upgraded to Node.js 24
title.zh: 内置 Node.js 运行环境升级至 Node.js 24

description.en: Upgraded automatically on first launch, so agents that need Node.js 24, such as the latest OpenClaw, install and update normally. Agents and settings are kept; macOS below 13.5 stays on Node.js 22.
description.zh: 更新后首次启动时自动升级，最新版 OpenClaw 等需要 Node.js 24 的智能体可正常安装和更新。智能体与设置均保留，macOS 13.5 以下仍使用 Node.js 22。

description.en: Live refresh now reads only new log lines instead of the whole file, and entries no longer repeat.
description.zh: 实时刷新只读取新增日志，不再反复读取整个文件，条目也不再重复显示。

title.en: Feature tours follow the dark theme
title.zh: 功能导览适配深色主题

description.en: Tour banners and tours on Browser, Routines, Tasks and Workflows are now readable in the dark theme.
description.zh: 浏览器、定时任务、任务和工作流的导览横幅及导览内容在深色主题下清晰可读。

title.en: Clearer messages when an agent install fails
title.zh: 智能体安装失败时的提示更准确

description.en: When an install leaves no working command, the message names the failed step and shows the installer's last output line.
description.zh: 安装后未生成可用命令时，提示会指明失败环节，并附上安装程序的最后一行输出。

title.zh: 修正 Windows 上「在文件夹中显示」的文案

description.en: The install-log link no longer mentions Finder on Windows and Linux.
description.zh: 安装日志链接在 Windows 和 Linux 上不再显示为「在访达中显示」。
